borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Binance's iOS app is a dark, dense, data-first trading terminal compressed into a phone. The default and dominant experience is dark mode: a near-black canvas (`#0B0E11`) onto which thousands of live numbers stream — prices, percentages, order books, candlesticks, P&L. The atmosphere is "professional exchange, not consumer wallet." Where Coinbase rounds its corners and pads generously to feel friendly, Binance tightens everything: 12pt row paddings, hairline `#2B3139` dividers, and tabular monospace figures so that a markets list shows ten pairs without scrolling. The screen should feel like a Bloomberg terminal that happens to fit in a hand — information density is a feature, not a flaw.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: The single brand accent is Binance Yellow (`#F0B90B`) — a saturated amber-gold that appears on the logo, the primary "Convert"/"Deposit" CTA, the active tab, selected market-tab underlines, and links. It is used sparingly and deliberately: yellow means "this is the Binance action." Everything else is carried by semantic market color: green (`#0ECB81`) for up / buy / bids, red (`#F6465D`) for down / sell / asks. These two colors are absolute and never invert between themes — green is always up, red is always down, because a trader's muscle memory depends on it. The candlestick chart uses the same green/red for bullish/bearish candles.

do: 建议：Use the deep canvas {#0B0E11} as the default — Binance is dark-native。
建议：Make Binance Yellow {#F0B90B} the *only* brand accent (CTA, active tab, links)。
建议：Set ALL numbers in monospace with tabular figures so columns align。
建议：Keep green {#0ECB81} = up/buy and red {#F6465D} = sell/down — absolute, never inverted。
建议：Use dense 12pt row padding and 1pt {#2B3139} hairline dividers in lists。
dont: 避免：use white or any color other than {#F0B90B} for the primary CTA。
避免：render prices/percentages in a proportional sans — alignment breaks。
避免：invert up/down colors in light mode (green stays up, red stays down)。
避免：pad rows generously "to feel friendly" — density is the Binance identity。
避免：put white text on the yellow button (fails contrast and is off-brand)。
